title: Formal instruction: complete the form
instructions: Choose the option that expresses the intended meaning, forms a natural word partnership and fits the situation.

parts.prompt: A formal email from the school office says: ‘Please ___ the attached form and return it by Friday.’

choice_rationales.A: Sort out is informal and means resolve or organise a problem; it does not precisely instruct the reader to supply every required answer.
choice_rationales.B: Complete the form is a clear, neutral-formal instruction to provide all required information.
choice_rationales.C: Fill over is not the natural verb-and-particle partnership for supplying information on a form.
choice_rationales.D: Deal with is too vague because it does not state what the reader must do to the form.

parts.hint: Use the exact supplied frame and the school-office audience. Check every verb-and-particle partnership as written.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Complete the attached form’ is grammatically complete, precise and appropriately neutral-formal for an office email.
